readingNotes.global:
Read each document separately, with its own page evidence.
Extract every observable applicable checklist fact, regardless of user intent.
Never turn assessed areas into identified needs without explicit support.
Preserve negative findings; do not infer missing information from silence alone.
Keep observed measurements distinct from targets, baselines and planned services.
Do not invent dates, people, document IDs or repeated-row identity.
Never use the case manifest as evidence for the current-document extraction.
An observed concern or assessed area does not itself establish an identified need.
Capture referral observations, future parent-input plans, and next steps separately from documented parent input.
Capture evaluation-plan information available and information to gather as separate repeated source rows.
Link document references as evidence-backed proposals; never fabricate target document identities.
Goal baseline is a plan value, not a second post-baseline progress measurement; restated sources remain separate.
Do not infer a conflict without overlapping time and same resolved property; unknown timing stays unresolved.

byDocumentType.iep_initial: Read every goal/service/accommodation row and effective date, including repeated entries.
byDocumentType.iep_annual: Capture prior-plan references and preserve effective periods.
byDocumentType.iep_amendment: Extract target plan and exactly which lines changed; do not replace unrelated items.
byDocumentType.progress_report: Extract each actual dated result and goal reference; do not infer improvement without compatible series.
byDocumentType.academic_evaluation: Separate assessed area, finding, explicit need and recommendation.
byDocumentType.psychoeducational_evaluation: Functional cognitive observations are not automatically identified special-education needs.
byDocumentType.speech_language_evaluation: Explicit negative findings remain negative; no diagnosis must not be rewritten as a need.
byDocumentType.referral: Read narrative details and parent input planning when explicitly present; distinguish planned from received input.
byDocumentType.evaluation_plan: Extract each information-available and information-to-gather row separately and keep consent-required text distinct from actual consent.

checks.question: What goal, if any, addresses the need described in the evaluation?
Where is the present-level description supporting this goal?
How do the documented progress results compare with the goal target?
How is this accommodation reflected in the assessment participation section?
How will progress toward this goal be measured?
Do the supplied referral records include the parent input referenced in the referral?
